meaning: An app that changes words from one language into another. You can type, speak, or point your camera at a sign.
clues: It helps people who do not speak the same language.
You can type into it, talk to it, or point your phone's camera at a menu.
It turns your words into another language, such as French or Spanish.
It is handy on trips, for reading signs and talking with shop workers.
It has two words. The first starts with T and the second is "app."
assumes: Subtitles are words shown at the bottom of a screen
A dictionary lists words and their meanings
A thesaurus lists words with similar meanings

decoys.meaning: Words shown at the bottom of a screen that match what people are saying.
A book or app that lists words with their meanings.
A book that lists words with similar meanings, to help you find another word.

exchange.text: Back in my day, we carried a thick phrasebook and pointed at the page. People were very kind about it.

exchange.text: Now your phone does the work. Tip: download a language first, and it can work without a signal.
